definitions.gloss: forensic autopsy; judicial autopsy; medico-legal autopsy
definitions.explanation: An autopsy ordered by a court or prosecutor to determine the cause of death in cases involving suspected crime or unnatural death. Performed by a forensic pathologist as part of a criminal investigation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{司法解剖|しほうかいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The police conducted a forensic autopsy.

examples.japanese: {司法解剖|しほうかいぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{死因|しいん}→死因：13224_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窒息|ちっそく}→窒息：16495_chissoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{判明|はんめい}→判明：11785_hanmei⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of the forensic autopsy, the cause of death was determined to be asphyxiation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{検察|けんさつ}→検察：11086_kensatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}て→得る：02014_eru⟧{司法解剖|しほうかいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Because there were suspicious points, the prosecution obtained court permission and decided to carry out a forensic autopsy.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{司法|しほう}→司法：09663_shihou⟧ (judicial, legal) and ⟦{解剖|かいぼう}→解剖：14191_kaibou⟧ (dissection, autopsy). In Japan, {司法解剖|しほうかいぼう} requires a warrant from a judge and is specifically for criminal investigations, unlike {行政解剖|ぎょうせいかいぼう} (administrative autopsy) which does not require a warrant.

A common term in crime news, detective fiction, and legal dramas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {司法解剖|しほうかいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform a forensic autopsy
- {司法解剖|しほうかいぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: results of the forensic autopsy
- {司法解剖|しほうかいぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧: to request a forensic autopsy
- {司法解剖|しほうかいぼう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{死因|しいん}→死因：13224_shiin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}する→特定する：19642_tokuteisuru⟧: to determine cause of death through forensic autopsy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {行政解剖|ぎょうせいかいぼう}: administrative autopsy — autopsy for non-criminal unnatural deaths
- {病理解剖|びょうりかいぼう}: pathological autopsy — autopsy to study disease, performed in hospitals
- ⟦{解剖|かいぼう}→解剖：14191_kaibou⟧: autopsy, dissection — the general term
